context: Applied the 8 code-review findings to the twining_triage implementation (feat/triage). Five were already applied in the working tree (verified): the stdout assertion moved before mockRestore in triage-tools.test.ts, the sqlite-backend HTTP suite in triage-api.test.ts (describe.skipIf(!HAS_SQLITE) seeding twining.db directly), deep-link routing by item.kind via deepLinkTab in main.js, the normalized stableKey DOM-stability gate in triage-view.js, and the /api/triage 500 error-path test. Newly changed this session: window_ms=Infinity now applies as an unbounded window per the §4.1 letter (triage.ts normalize accepts any number > 0; engine + HTTP tests flipped and a NaN-defaults test added). Full npm test: 107 files passed, 1401 passed | 2 skipped. npm run build clean.
rationale: verified eager createStores on an uninitialized project resolves to sqlite and openDatabase would create .twining/twining.db, materializing state on a project the route must report initialized:false for, breaking the §10.11 zero-shape tests. Lazy-once satisfies the sentence's normative core (construct once, never per request — no sqlite connection churn); the fs.existsSync guard runs before getTriageStores so uninitialized projects never touch stores.
summary: Kept the lazy-once triage StoreSet in createApiHandler over the spec §7 letter (eager construction in the closure)
